text: Nine p.m.! A storm rips through the mansion... and the power goes out!
The lights come back on... and the diamond? Gone!
Four suspects. One of them... is lying!
Number one, the butler: I was lighting candles in the hall!
Two, the maid: I was in the kitchen, making tea!
Three, the gardener: I was outside, closing the greenhouse. I heard the thunder... and then I saw the lightning!
Four, the niece: I was upstairs, reading with my phone's flashlight!
Comment the number! The answer drops in the next video!
